Description
This stunning Kitsilano gem is an absolute must see! 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathroom main level features a perfect layout for your family. Main floor contains a spacious living/dining area with cozy gas fireplace, natural hard wood flooring, large windows for plenty of natural light, clean neutral wall tones. A chef's dream of a kitchen! Plenty of storage within the wood cabinetry, large center island with stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and surrounding windows. Primary and secondary bedrooms are located on the main level with one bathroom and a ensuite to the primary. Downstairs holds the third bedroom, full bathroom, private laundry, and a large 4th bedroom (no closet) /could also be used as a rec room/office/ kids play area- the options are endless!

A perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience!

Experience refined West Coast living in this custom Brandes luxury home, tucked in Point Grey’s coveted North of 4th. A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. A private elevator connects all three levels, leading to a chef’s kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom millwork, a wine cellar, and a private theater. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Exquisite UNFURNISHED 4 bdrm, 3 bath waterfront house on prestigious Point Grey Road offering 3,825 sq ft of spacious living w/ spectacular ocean & mountain views. Upper floor features master suite w/ ensuite, walk-in closet & private deck overlooking water, plus 2 bright additional bedrooms w/ shared bath. Main level showcases dramatic sunken living rm w/ fireplace & large windows framing waterfront views, open-concept kitchen w/ s/s appls & granite counters, family rm & dining area. Garden level offers self-contained suite w/ kitchenette, ideal for in-law, caregiver or visiting family. Extensive outdoor spaces incl. patio & deck w/ direct water access, beautifully landscaped private yard. Pets upon approval.
